text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: No waaaay! You've gotten even sharper!!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Ah, Tamamo-san! Were you watching me?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"Well, I couldn't miss it even if I tried. 
What's up, did you do some special 
training or somethin'?"

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"It's not really worth mentioning, but... 
Trainer and I—"

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(Yeah, totally, me too— ...Wait, like hell 
I would!!)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(Wait, you weren't thinking about anything 
at aaaaall?!)

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Ummm... Are you waiting for me to play the 
straight man here...?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
No no no, you've got it all wrong! That's 
not what I mean at all!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Reacting to the setup, choosing the right 
words, deciding the right timing...

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
I really think this explosive power could 
be super useful for running!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Hmm... ...Still, you might have a 
point.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Well then, guess I gotta thank my Trainer 
for playing the fool just the right 
amount! Hahaha!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Honestly... I really found myself a 
great Trainer who's real fun to be with.
